current_bottleneck: A single global latent improves path-level center behavior, surface validity, and daily-change law, but conditional independence at each daily step still destroys cross-cell geometry. The decoder needs a shared stochastic channel at the step level or the 307 family is capped.
last_result_summary: 307a-v0 used one global path latent with a token-mixing AR decoder and diagonal Student-t step likelihood. It scored 2/11, passing surface and block_ar. It improved calibration error to 0.036, change KS to 24/25, and aggregate MR ratio to 0.764 with full-horizon aggregate profile pass, but cross-cell correlation collapsed further (corr ratio 0.079, rank ratio 4.293), level KS stayed weak at 4/25, and pathwise max-jump KS remained 0.318.
next_step_recommendation: Run a post-experiment analysis before another latent variant. Decide whether the 307 family needs one more clean repair with a low-dimensional per-step shared innovation on top of the global latent, or whether the latent-AR line should be abandoned as another capped branch.
